name: Codex with Config
description: Configures OpenAI Codex CLI with host-side configuration for seamless authentication.

version.description: Version of Codex CLI to install (e.g. 'latest' or a specific release like '0.161.0').

installMethod.description: Installation method: 'standalone' (official installer, no Node.js required) or 'npm' (requires Node.js in the base image).

postCreateCommand: if [ -d /codex_config ]; then sudo chgrp -R "$(id -g)" /codex_config && sudo chmod -R g+rwX /codex_config && sudo find /codex_config -type d -exec chmod g+s {} +; fi; if [ ! -e "$HOME/.codex" ]; then ln -s /codex_config "$HOME/.codex"; fi; grep -q "alias codex=" "$HOME/.bashrc" 2>/dev/null || echo "alias codex='codex -s danger-full-access --search'" >> "$HOME/.bashrc"; grep -q "alias codex=" "$HOME/.zshrc" 2>/dev/null || echo "alias codex='codex -s danger-full-access --search'" >> "$HOME/.zshrc"
